tests.title: Private Hire Driver Badge Rules — Mock Test 1

questions.question: Your PHV driver badge must be:
options: Worn or visibly displayed while working
questions.explanation: Drivers must display the TfL-issued ID while working.

questions.question: If you lose your badge, you must:
options: Apply to TfL for a replacement
questions.explanation: Only TfL may issue or replace official ID.

questions.question: Allowing another person to use your badge is:
options: A criminal offence and grounds for revocation
questions.explanation: Misuse of the badge is treated very seriously.

questions.question: When your badge expires you must:
questions.explanation: An expired badge means you cannot legally work as a PHV driver.

questions.question: If TfL request to inspect your badge, you must:
questions.explanation: Compliance with licensing inspections is mandatory.

questions.question: Damaged or unreadable badges should be:
The badge contains:
questions.explanation: It shows the driver's photo and unique licence number.
